venira.output_kind: One key per report section (see sections); with sections set, also sections_requested and sections_unknown.
venira.speed_profile: fast (~a few ms + 1 audit DB query); set include_audit=false to skip the DB query.
venira.use_when: you debug slowness or errors, or want the security warnings before risky work. include_audit=false skips the audit query.

description:
Server diagnostics: version, workspace, security posture and warnings, caches, queue, running shells, latency, snapshot store, audit status.
Use when: you debug slowness or errors, or want the security warnings before risky work. include_audit=false skips the audit query.
Avoid when: normal file work.
Output: One key per report section (see sections); with sections set, also sections_requested and sections_unknown.

include_audit.description: true includes the audit-log summary in the result (default true); false skips the audit DB query.

sections.description: Report sections to return: notice, server, corehost, capability, queue, caches, shells, approvals, warnings, posture, snapshots, secrets, network, metrics, cache, trace, shell, environment, audit. caches/shells are live state; cache/shell are configuration. Omit for everything; use it when the full payload does not fit the response.
